description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractPersistentActorWithTimersAndCleanup' extending Akka's 'AbstractPersistentActorWithTimers'. It provides functionality for handling cleanup commands by deleting persisted snapshots and events up to the latest snapshot sequence number, including methods for managing cleanup responses and internal cleanup state.

classes.name: AbstractPersistentActorWithTimersAndCleanup
classes.description: An abstract class extending Akka's 'AbstractPersistentActorWithTimers' that adds cleanup functionality for deleting snapshots and events up to the latest snapshot sequence number.

methods.name: getLatestSnapshotSequenceNumber
methods.description: Abstract method to return the latest persisted snapshot sequence number.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling for cleanup commands and responses.

methods.name: staleEventsKeptAfterCleanup
methods.description: Returns the number of stale events to keep after cleanup; default is 0.

methods.name: handleCleanupCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming cleanup commands, initiates cleanup if needed.

methods.name: handleDeleteSnapshotsResponse
methods.description: Handles responses for delete snapshot requests.

methods.name: handleDeleteMessagesResponse
methods.description: Handles responses for delete message requests.

methods.name: checkCleanupCompleted
methods.description: Checks if cleanup responses are received and whether cleanup was successful.

methods.name: isCleanupCompletedSuccessfully
methods.description: Determines if cleanup succeeded based on responses.

methods.name: getResponseStatus
methods.description: Generates a string describing the status of a cleanup response message.

methods.name: startCleanup
methods.description: Initiates cleanup by deleting snapshots and messages up to specified sequence numbers.
